name: Remove the startup-app launch delay (SSD systems)
description: Startup apps launch immediately after sign-in instead of after Explorer's built-in delay.
benefit: The desktop is fully ready sooner after sign-in on fast storage.
drawback: All startup apps start at once; on HDDs or weak CPUs this makes the first minute after sign-in slower, which is why it is limited to SSD systems.
recommendedFor: Mid-range and high-end PCs with Windows on an SSD.
evidence: Explorer reads this value at sign-in; effect is limited to the first seconds after logon.

name: Disable Fast Startup
description: Shut down performs a full shutdown instead of hibernating the kernel session.
mechanism: Sets HiberbootEnabled=0 under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Power (Control Panel › Power Options › 'Turn on fast startup').
benefit: Drivers and the kernel fully reinitialise on every boot, which avoids long-uptime driver issues, applies driver/firmware updates reliably and helps dual-boot setups.
drawback: Cold boots take a few seconds longer.
recommendedFor: Gaming PCs that are shut down daily, dual-boot systems, troubleshooting.
evidence: Documented Fast Startup behaviour. Restart already performs a full boot regardless of this setting.

name: Don't reopen apps automatically after sign-in
description: Turns off 'Automatically save my restartable apps and restart them when I sign back in'.
mechanism: Sets RestartApps=0 under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon (Settings › Accounts › Sign-in options).
benefit: Fewer apps competing for resources right after sign-in.
drawback: Previously open apps are not restored after a restart.
recommendedFor: Users who prefer a clean desktop after reboot.

name: Show detailed status messages during startup/shutdown
description: Windows shows what it is doing (e.g. 'Stopping services') instead of 'Please wait'.
mechanism: Sets VerboseStatus=1 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System ('Display highly detailed status messages').
benefit: Helps diagnose slow boots or shutdowns.

name: Close hung apps automatically at shutdown
description: Windows ends unresponsive apps at shutdown/sign-out without asking.
benefit: Shutdown and restart are not blocked by 'This app is preventing shutdown'.
drawback: Unsaved work in apps that don't respond is lost without a prompt.
recommendedFor: Users who always save before shutting down.
